I wasn't sure how to interpret Palomar verification failure in the Axiom PrimeGapsLib submission, but I asked Claude and it said it was because the verification scripts weren't handling module system oleans correctly. For context, the submitted Challenge file uses the module system, as does the rest of the repository. It should pass the comparator check...

Is this a bug in how Palomar handles module system submissions? (I could also just not be reading this correctly, would appreciate some help...)

@Sidharth Hariharan just a heads up first, it's not a good idea to post the submission links on Zulip (or anywhere public). Someone could use this to modify/withdraw/finalize your submission. The URL is the password.
This is fixed now. (I'm re-running the failed step of your submission.)

@Sidharth Hariharan, I wasn't able to re-run it completely. You'll need to resubmit. (It will complain that you need a project.description field in your formalization.yaml file. You can either do this yourself ahead of time, or the submission process should assist you in making a PR.
Sorry, hold that... fixing more module related problems. :-(
@Sidharth Hariharan, if you would like to try again now, that would be great.
Thank you so much @Kim Morrison! I've resubmitted.
